instructions.zh: 在 Steam 库中右键点击幻兽帕鲁，选择「管理」→「浏览本地文件」。
instructions.en: Right-click Palworld in your Steam library and choose Manage → Browse local files.

instructions.zh: 依次双击 Pal → Binaries → Win64。找到 UE4SS.log，选中后拖入日志上传区域；如果这里没有，请打开 ue4ss 文件夹查找。
instructions.en: Double-click Pal → Binaries → Win64 in order. Select UE4SS.log and drag it into the log upload area. If it is not there, look inside the ue4ss folder.

instructions.zh: 只有作者要求时，才需添加日志同目录的 UE4SS-settings.ini。填写昵称后点击发送。没有日志时，请告知作者；不要用其他文件代替。
instructions.en: Add UE4SS-settings.ini from the same folder as the log only if the author requests it. Enter your nickname and click Send. If there is no log, tell the author; do not substitute another file.
